name: jiayi-ads-analytics-expert
description: Multi-platform ads operations & analytics expert for Baidu, Google, Bing, 360, and Tencent Ads

displayDescription.en: Not just analytics — directly operate ad platforms via API: bid adjustments, keyword management, budget changes, creative management, plus structured daily reports
displayDescription.zh: 不止分析，更能直接操盘——通过API调价、暂停词、加否词、改预算、上下创意，五大广告平台一句话搞定

defaultInitPrompt.en: Generate a comprehensive multi-channel ad performance daily report for yesterday, including SEM and display analysis with optimization recommendations
